title: 8 November 1968: George Harrison produces Is This What You Want? by Jackie Lomax
content:
There was a seven-day break between the sixth and this, the seventh, Los Angeles recording session for Jackie Lomax’s debut album Is This What You Want?

George Harrison produced the album for fellow Liverpudlian Lomax. It was released by Apple in March 1969.

During this day’s session musician Paul Beaver added synthesizer to the song ‘I Fall Inside Your Eyes’. Harrison didn’t perform on the song.
